code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Seed colors mark a repeated 2x2 block motif; replicate on matching solid 2x2
    # positions within the 1-pattern.
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors=[v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,1)]
    for color in colors:
        # color every 2x2 solid block aligned to the seed block's parity
        seed=next(( (r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color),None)
        if seed is None: continue
        r0,c0=seed
        for r in range(h-1):
            for c in range(w-1):
                if all(grid[y][x]==1 for y,x in ((r,c),(r+1,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c+1))) and (r-r0)%2==0 and (c-c0)%2==0:
                    for y in (r,r+1):
                        for x in (c,c+1): g[y][x]=color
        g[r0][c0]=color
    return g
'''
